_note: A choice list's options have a value a rule and the API use (digitaal) and a label a person reads (Digitaal). The new-case form reads a field's options by these labels (DqNieuweZaak Gewenste vorm, Soort verzoeker); an option without one shows its value. A fragment rather than an edit to dossiq_register.json, per ADR-037.

enumLabels.title: Option labels
enumLabels.description: What a person reads per choice list option, by the option's value (digitaal: Digitaal). An option without one shows its value.
